newsitem.title: USA: Komag tumbles after Q4 forecast,downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Komag tumbles after Q4 forecast,downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Komag Corp tumbled in mid-morning trade on Tuesday, weighed by an earnings forecast that was below expectations and an analyst's downgrade.
Shares in the computer disk drive component maker fell 5-1/4 to 27-3/4 on volume of 3.2 million shares.
On Tuesday, PaineWebber cut its rating for Komag Inc to neutral from attractive, market sources said.
The Milpitas, Calif., company said after the market closed on Monday its fourth-quarter results would be below expectations and fall below those reported for the third quarter.
It had predicted that its earnings per share for the fourth quarter would be higher than the $0.31 a share in the third quarter but below the $0.72 recorded in the fourth quarter of 1995.
